rubric.retrieval: Exact expected resource set; extra rows and omitted rows both fail. Body-search is a target capability, not a claim that v3 promised full-text search.
rubric.original: Exact evidence quote in frozen original; does not assess generated answers.
rubric.characterScope: Use existing FrozenResourceScopeV1.characterId to probe knowledge metadata. Not an end-user exploit or proof that a product leaked secrets.
rubric.unsupported: Missing typed query/simulation operations are recorded, never stubbed as passing.
rubric.impact: Exact downstream review set. Micro precision/recall report TP/FP/FN; an empty gold set has no per-case recall denominator. Current graph is conservative review, not auto-deletion.
rubric.lexical: Literal full-text lookup over the same authored source units; 24 eligible queries only. No LLM, embeddings, or semantic answer scoring.
rubric.gold: Explicit text/evidence and agent-reviewed closed-world inference; no human quality scores.
rubric.manualControls: Supplemental fixture assertions explicitly place A at an old/new relay station to test superseded state retention, and confirm/lock B knowledge of a rule. These are controlled metadata, not story extraction or semantic QA gold.
rubric.sourcePlan: Exact-key positive controls and count-only negative controls are separate. Empty prohibited selectors describe an unimplemented product policy, not proof of access to a forbidden resource.
